results.title: Winn_Parcels
results.description: This layer contains polygons representing parcel ownership for Winneshiek County, Iowa. It represents map features similar to those previously shown on hand drawn tax maps. The geometry was created by the Schneider Corporation using coordinate geometry (COGO) software in an ArcGIS environment.  Individual parcel features were digitized from official recorded documents when available.  Special care was taken to correlate map features with survey controlled coordinate values of the Public Land Survey System (PLSS).
results.snippet: This digital, geographically referenced data set is vital in supporting property and land record operations of Winneshiek County Iowa.

results.title: AddressesPublic_view
results.description:
This layer includes the authoritative address points for Winneshiek County, Iowa. It serves as the primary and most up-to-date source for address locations within the county. The layer is updated on a monthly basis from a database maintained by Winneshiek County GIS, ensuring the accuracy and currency of the data.
This layer is ideal for various applications and analyses requiring accurate address data, including:
  • Emergency Services Dispatch
  • Parcel Management and Assessment
  • Urban Planning and Development
  • Demographic Analysis
  • Routing and Navigation
Data source
The data originates from a geodatabase, maintained by the Winneshiek County IT department, which serves as the official record of addresses within the county.
Update frequency
The layer is updated monthly to reflect changes and additions to the address database.
Usage
This layer is intended to be the primary source for address points in Winneshiek County. The layer is shared with the organization so that it can be used in any applications or analyses requiring precise and current address information within the area. Users are encouraged to create views of this layer as needed for their own applications. This layer should not be used directly in applications and is not intended for editing in web maps or applications. Any joined views created by users may be removed if changes to the schema of this layer are required.
results.snippet: This is a public view layer of the address publishing feature service. It is maintained for use in public applications requiring county address points.
results.accessInformation: Winneshiek County GIS Department; Winneshiek County Emergency Management; Winneshiek County Board. Data is maintained in collaboration with local emergency services and county staff.
